When आत्मनेपद affixes follow, वध् is optionally the substitute of हन् in the लुङ् (Aorist).

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

After the verbs लिप् , सिच् and ह्वे अङ् is optionally the substitute of च्लि when the affixes of the आत्मनेपद follow.

Terms: च्लि

And the affix णिनि comes after the verb मन् 'to think' when the word in composition with it is a word with a case-affix and when it is used to signify thought, whereof the object is self (the sense of the affix being 'thinking himself as such').

Terms: णिनि

The affix ख comes in the sense of 'good for that' after the words आत्मन् and विश्वजन and after the compounds having the word भोग as their second term

Terms:

The Instrumental -3rd case endings after आत्मान् are not elided when an Ordinal Numeral follows.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

The finals of the अङ्ग (stems) आत्मन् and अध्वन् remain unchanged before the affix ख।

Terms: प्रकृति भाव

अत् is always the substitute of झ in the आत्मनेपद when it is not preceded by a verbal अङ्ग (stem) ending in अ।

Terms: Some substitution
